There have been heart-breaking incidents reported in which patients were denied an organ transplant or removed from the transplant waiting list due to their COVID-19 vaccination status.

Today I introduced legislation that would stop this discrimination.

We’ve said it all along: the entire Biden family is compromised. 
 
If the Bidens walk away indictment-free, it will be one of the most corrupt failures of the United States Justice system.
 
I call on AG Garland to immediately appoint a Special Counsel.

I’m glad to introduce legislation that will provide Medicare beneficiaries with more flexibility in their treatment options and will help lower the risk of individuals turning to opioids for pain management.

Alvin Bragg didn’t expect Congress to exercise our oversight powers when he made the unprecedented and politically motivated choice to go after President Trump?

I remain concerned that some nonprofit hospitals are not providing the charity care that their nonprofit status requires. 

I joined the @WaysandMeansGOP Oversight Subcommittee to discuss. https://t.co/GgCgv7RyaM

Illegal immigrants are threatening the stability of the U.S. healthcare system.

Vulnerable patients are already being turned away due to locations providing health services for a massive number of illegals.The Biden administration is to blame. Sanctuary cities are to blame.

I joined my @WaysandMeansGOP colleagues in asking what the Biden administration plans to do. Our country cannot sustain the influx of 10 million+ illegals!

https://t.co/fQwVJrUCzs

Congress can end the unfair practice of hospital 'dishonest billing' by passing the FAIR Act, which I co-sponsored. 

This bill ensures that patients visiting a doctor's office won't be billed for a hospital visit they never made!

Read more: https://t.co/BVZtlj8LaG

Commercial properties are generally ineligible for debris removal under the FEMA Public Assistance program.
 
Commercial properties may be able to work through their insurance company or SBA to file a claim for storm debris removal: https://t.co/KBqYEOloRa
 
My bill, the Clean Up DEBRIS Act, would fix this problem by making our condos, HOA’s, mobile home parks, and other private communities eligible after major hurricanes for the same FEMA debris assistance as other homeowners.
 
This is a longstanding issue in Florida. I filed this bill after Hurricane Ian, and it’s more important than ever that the House swiftly passes my legislation.

The Biden-Harris administration has weaponized federal agencies to punish political opponents and censor speech on everything from elections to public health. @Weaponization isn’t stopping our investigations to expose this corruption and censorship.

With @realDonaldTrump back in the White House, we can dismantle this culture of corruption and restore accountability in our government.

I filed a discharge petition for the bipartisan Sunshine Protection Act introduced by @VernBuchanan, which aims to make Daylight Saving Time permanent nationwide.

Changing clocks is an outdated and disruptive ritual.
Permanent DST brings better health, safer roads, lower crime, and a stronger economy.

It's time to lock the clock and keep our extra sunshine year-round for the benefit of all Americans.

l urge all my colleagues to sign on!

🔗https://t.co/0UOQuW6mXn

Attention Medicare Beneficiaries!

Medicare’s Annual Enrollment Period (AEP) runs from October 15 through December 7.

In response to federal regulations, many Medicare Advantage plans will be changing core or supplemental benefits, raising rates, and in some cases exiting local markets.

Please read your Annual Notice of Change letter carefully and review your Medicare Advantage and Part D plan coverage options to see if there’s a better match for your personal needs and finances.

Need assistance? Help from Medicare is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, except some federal holidays.

• 1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227)
• TTY users can call 1-877-486-2048

The bill fully funds rebuilding the Francis Scott Key Bridge.
A man-made accident caused the collapse and taxpayers are now on the hook for billions of dollars?

The company at fault–and their insurance–should be paying for this. Not the American taxpayer. https://t.co/6wSuNBb3Md

The CR also piles on more federal regulations in telecommunications, healthcare, and financial services.

More red tape. Higher compliance costs. An expanded administrative state that makes life harder for everyday Americans.

Veterans earned quality and timely healthcare.

No more hung-up phone calls. No more waiting until it’s too late. No more lives lost because they’re ignored.

My bill, the Veterans True Choice Act, gives our veterans immediate options when it comes to their healthcare. It gives service-connected disabled veterans the ability to continue using the VA or allow them to access private healthcare providers through TRICARE Select or TRICARE for Life.

Thank you, @HouseVetAffairs for holding a hearing on this life changing legislation. My fellow veterans and I are eager to get this bill across the finish line.

Medicare’s restrictions prevent seniors from accessing the full scope of chiropractic care—services often covered by private insurance and the VA.

The Chiropractic Medicare Coverage Modernization Act expands coverage, offering non-drug alternatives to pain management and will help to reduce reliance on opioids.

I’m glad to join @RepJohnLarson, @SenKevinCramer and @SenBlumenthal, in this bipartisan effort to prioritize seniors’ health and treatment options.

https://t.co/sNft657oZT

Today, I reintroduced the ACCESS Act with @RepKatCammack—a commonsense, fiscally responsible plan to expand Health Savings Accounts (HSAs) for millions of lower-income Americans.

This bill puts patients in control by offering a personal health care option that increases access to affordable treatments, trusted doctors, and essential therapies through tax-free, directly funded health savings accounts. It streamlines existing health subsidies, saving taxpayers tens of billions of dollars.

https://t.co/1V6Ph6XpMM

Sitting in this Ways & Means markup, I’m thinking about proposing a bill to make Trump Derangement Syndrome eligible for Medicare. 

Half of this committee would instantly qualify.

I just introduced the Women’s Protection in Telehealth Act to prevent taxpayer dollars from subsidizing providers who prescribe abortion-inducing drugs without in-person medical oversight.

This bill permanently excludes these providers from Medicare to protect women’s health and halt the unchecked expansion of abortion via telehealth.

The Biden administration removed safeguards, allowing mail-order abortion pills with zero in-person medical requirements. It’s time to stop this dangerous policy and protect both women and the unborn.
https://t.co/tYfzbwHexM

President Trump has called for one bold reconciliation bill to deliver the America First agenda—no piecemeal deals. 

House Republicans are ready to secure the border, cut taxes, and protect Social Security and Medicare. That means no tax on tips, making TCJA permanent, and real relief for working Americans!

Democrats have gone from deceit and deception to deadlock and dysfunction.

As border security collapsed and inflation skyrocketed, they bragged about Bidenomics and ignored the suffering of working-class communities.

When concerns were raised about Biden’s declining health, they gaslit the public and peddled “cheap fake” narratives to the press.

Now, Democrats are fighting among themselves about this CR—some eager to shut the government down while others flip-flop to avoid an electoral disaster.

No logo and rebranding effort can hide who the Democrats have become: the party of deadlock and dysfunction.

Families are the foundation of our economy, yet too many face financial hardship due to skyrocketing healthcare costs. Medical bills are cited as the leading cause of over 66% of personal bankruptcies in the U.S. It’s time for change.

Currently, Americans under 55 are restricted from contributing to their spouse’s Health Savings Account (HSA). This policy doesn’t make sense–and it’s holding families back.

Today, @RepFrenchHill and I introduced the Catch-Up Act, a bill that will empower all Americans to contribute to their spouse’s HSA, regardless of age.

This crucial step will promote financial security and ensure that healthcare is more accessible and affordable for everyone.

https://t.co/1ApjCowqYZ
